Name: Cannabis Kit - 1.6 for Content Patcher
Author: Necrofiend13
Description:
[center][size=4]﻿[img]https://cdn.dlcompare.com/others_jpg/upload/news/image/stardew-valley-1-6-update-is-out-3dcc33fe-image-3dcc33eb.jpg.webp[/img][/size][/center]

[size=4]Great news! Mayor Lewis has announced new legislation, making it legal to grow and sell Cannabis products in Pelican Town.[/size]

[b][size=6]Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

[size=4]Create your own medicinal compounds. [/size][b][u]Pierre, Harvey, Gus, and Krobus[/u][/b][size=4], now sell various new items and recipes.[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25214/25214-1718978764-1556915504.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25214/25214-1718806143-596253288.png[/img][/center]

- [b][u]*NEW*[/u][/b] Hemp crop for industrial use. Place 5 Hemp into Recycler for [b]Fiber[/b], Oil Extractor for [b]Oil[/b], Dehydrated into [b]Wood[/b], and spun on the Loom machine for [b]Cloth[/b].

- Adds more than[b] 10 new unique crops, and consumables[/b]. The items can be used, sold, or gifted around town.
- Place 5 fresh produce into the new Dehydrator machine to create Dried Artisan goods.
﻿Some objects take longer to dry than others, [b]between 3-5 in-game hours.[/b]
- [font=Georgia]Pierre[/font] now sells Tobacco products. (The Townsfolk have to get it from somewhere?)
- [font=Georgia]Harvey[/font] dispenses smokables and other medicinal ingredients [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25214/25214-1718806164-1533996110.png[/img]
﻿- Once you have unlocked each of the unique crafting recipes from [font=Georgia]Harvey[/font], he will send a gift to make quality Smokables (*Requires MFM*)
- [font=Georgia]Gus[/font] sells edibles [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25214/25214-1718806226-795894775.png[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25214/25214-1718806155-800111074.png[/img]
- [font=Georgia]Krobus[/font] has a unique item just for some fun, enjoy!

[size=5]The original mod(s) can be found [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1741]here[/url][/size] (Thank you for permission to update to 1.6) <3

Suggestions, Feedback or bug reports are highly appreciated. Please refer to Nexus, or visit my [url=https://discord.gg/pN3JSQfr]Discord[/url] page (NecroCrab's Mods)
Want to add a translation? Send me a request and a i18n language file. 

If you would like to support the ongoing development of this project, you can endorse me on Nexus. Alternatively, you could buy me a coffee, via [url=https://paypal.me/necrocrab?country.x=GB&locale.x=en_GB]Paypal
[/url]My other mods on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Necrofiend13/mods]Nexus[/url]﻿ and [url=https://modrinth.com/mod/prehistoric-dinosaurs]Modrinth[/url]
